name: Ancient Spirit
label: Quest
description: Ancient Spirit: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Felwood was once a peaceful and serene land... Until the legion took hold. The infernals, destruction, chaos...
The skull of Gul'dan ensured that none were spared here. All fell to the corruption.

Even now, as a spirit, I still find myself trapped, bearing the suffering of this land. Help me find my way home. Please, friend, tell me you will lead an ancient spirit away from here, where I may finally rest.
Once I am free, seek out Kayneth Stillwind, a druid that resides in Forest Song, to the east.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What have you seen in this corrupted land?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, friend. Felwood has been through much hardship. Thank you for what you have done.
One day, we may be able to reclaim Felwood from the corruption; every kind deed helps.
